SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-06: CQL — Type Operators - Conversion Checks. Test these items: CanConvertQuantity, ConvertQuantity, ConvertsToBoolean, ConvertsToDate, ConvertsToDateTime, ConvertsToDecimal, ConvertsToLong, ConvertsToInteger, ConvertsToQuantity, ConvertsToRatio, ConvertsToString, ConvertsToTime. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
